messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We appreciate your detailed response; however, as a proud family-run foundry, it is our strict policy not to share internal cost breakdowns. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

For our primary quote, we can present a price of €137.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €134.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point.
